title: My Incubi Harem
description_short: My Incubi Harem is a visual novel about how you became an incubi king and ended up with beautiful men in love with you. Featuring a lewd mentor, a hot singer, a queer dom activist, a cold-hearted nobleman, and a sensible daddy. This is the first episode of a game series made by Male Doll.
